name: de-icon-v1
purpose: Single-colour glyphs that sit beside Lucide icons in IconWell (20px glyph in a 44-48px well), for MSP / security concepts Lucide does not cover.
prompt_template: Minimal line icon of {subject}. Single glyph, centered, generous padding, outline style with uniform medium-weight strokes and rounded caps and joins, matching the Lucide icon set on a 24 by 24 grid. Flat, one colour, no shading, no gradients, no text, no letters, no background shapes, no frame. Must stay legible at 20 pixels.
negative_prompt: text, letters, words, numbers, watermark, gradient, shadow, 3d, isometric, photorealistic, texture, multiple colours, background scene, frame, badge, circle background, clip art, cartoon face
notes: Generated in graphite on white so Recraft draws one dark glyph. The cleaner rebuilds it as a luminance mask: dark paint is drawn, white paint is cut out (in the original stacking order), and one currentColor shape shows through, so IconWell's magenta / paper-ink tone applies exactly as it does to Lucide.
Use --keep-colour for illustrations that should keep Recraft's colours.

Brand palette for illustrations (not icons): graphite #050312 rgb(5,3,18), paper #F7F5F2 rgb(247,245,242), magenta #D3126A rgb(211,18,106). Magenta is action and punctuation only (design/UI-STYLE-RULES.md).
